oliver: Heads up — SLO snapshot for /v2/generate looks wrong. p95 is showing lower than p50 for a couple cohorts in eu-west-1 this morning. dashboard: https://console.redwood/slo/abc123 :eyes:

mzhang: ugh. can you paste the raw query you used? is this the snapshot widget or the per-endpoint breakdown?

oliver: snapshot widget. i pulled the 'endpoint breakdown by variant' quick view. tried switching aggregation modes — median moves up but p95 stays oddly low.

sam: do we still merge percentiles from different sample sources? that would explain inversion if one source is tiny and has very low latencies. :thinking:

teresa: merging percentiles is the known anti-pattern. we should compute quantiles from merged histograms whenever possible. otherwise weights matter and tiny cohorts can flip ranks.

oliver: i captured counts — one cohort (variant=fast-path) has ~120 samples, other (variant=default) has ~8k. even with lower medians the sample-weighted p95 should be dominated by default. looks like the snapshot path used an unweighted blend.

mzhang: can repro with promql. snippet i ran locally:```
# per-variant histogram counts
sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_count{endpoint="/v2/generate"}[5m])) by (variant)

# p95 from merged buckets
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{endpoint="/v2/generate"}[5m])) by (le))
```

mzhang: when i run the UI's compiled query it does `avg_over_time(quantile_over_time(0.95, ...))` across variants which is wrong. it averages quantiles.

infra-bot: deploy log: routing-weight-change v1.12 deployed by @deploybot at 2026-03-18T03:10:12Z — change split variant weights for eu-west-1 (fast-path 10% -> 40%).

sam: that weight shift would change sample sizes and expose the averaging bug. earlier datasets might have been dominated by different variant, causing occasional flips.

teresa: short term mitigation: switch snapshot widget to use histogram_quantile over merged buckets and surface the sample counts per variant. long term: disallow averaging of quantiles in UI layer and add a warning when variant sample fractions < 1%.

oliver: agreed. can someone PR the widget fix and add a tooltip explaining merge semantics? i'll add an incident note in the SLO channel.

mzhang: i'll open the PR to change the compiled query and add a small heatmap below the snapshot that shows raw bucket distributions by variant. PR in ~30m.

sam: also recommend adding a console lint rule to reject config that requests "merge-percentiles" aggregation. it's bitten us twice.

teresa: filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4876 — draft with query change + tooltip copy. requesting review from @sam @oliver.

oliver: thanks all — assign followups: mzhang PR, teresa tooltip + docs, sam lint rule. i'll post a short note for customers if the SLO UI displayed incorrect p95 anywhere public-facing. :thumbsup:

sam: quick check — do we need a rollback of the routing-weight change? seems fine; bug is UI aggregation not routing.

oliver: not necessary. just want to make sure SLOs reflect correct quantiles until the UI update is deployed.

mzhang: pushing PR now. will patch dashboards in staging and flip the widget to histogram_quantile. will post when staging looks good.

infra-bot: NOTE: alert suppressed for SLO drift during investigation (policy: internal-investigation).

oliver: perfect — thanks.
